Extensive Sim Generator

Base Game Only keeps traits, aspirations, and preferences to true base-game content. Custom Packs lets you toggle official packs. Mod creators include Custom Generator, JayESims, Wicked Pixxel, Chingyu, NateTheL0ser, KiaraSims4Mods, SACRIFICIAL, SpinningPlumbobs, TURBODRIVER, Maplebell, Khlas, EllaNoir, Spent, Mythical Ascelin, Nisa K., ilkavelle, JaneSimsten, llazyneiph, and Lumpinou.

Lock sections you want to keep before generating again. Choose Any in the new controls to randomize that part each generation.
Generator Help
Quick notes for the current version.
Basic use
  • Pick the controls you care about, then press Generate.
  • Use Any when you want that part randomized.
  • Single Sim gives the most detailed character result. Household gives a group result.
Lite Mode and Full Mode
  • Full Mode shows all current tabs.
  • Lite Mode hides deeper extra tabs so the generator feels cleaner.
  • You do not need to regenerate after switching between Lite and Full Mode.
Story controls
  • Era controls the time period flavor, such as medieval, modern, or future.
  • Story Tone controls the overall vibe of the story.
  • Backstory Tone controls what shaped the Sim before gameplay begins.
  • Challenge Pack gives a gameplay rule, pressure, or objective.
  • Do Not Generate blocks one broad type of content as much as possible.
Tabs
  • Overview gives the quick profile card.
  • Appearance gives face, body, style, and occult appearance details.
  • Personality gives traits, personality systems, talent, and weakness.
  • Preferences gives likes, dislikes, romance pattern, and relationship direction.
  • Skills gives generated skills and levels.
  • Family & Relationships gives family background, relationship hooks, and connected relationship details.
  • Home & Money gives world, home, funds, class, education, and home-story details.
  • Occult gives occult lore and generated occult features.
  • Story gives the main character story and gameplay direction.
  • Scenarios gives random story events to use when you need something to happen next.
  • World Fit explains local rumors, community role, and local conflict.
  • Seasonal Events gives seasonal story events.
  • Flaw in Action shows how the Sim’s flaw appears in gameplay.
  • Matching Household builds a household around the current Sim.
  • Legacy gives bloodline, inheritance, curse, relic, and generation rules when enabled.
  • Export lets you copy or export the current result.
  • Favorites stores favorite rolls in your browser.
Main buttons
  • Generate creates a new Sim or household.
  • Favorite saves the current result in your browser.
  • Export Favorites downloads a favorites backup file.
  • Import Favorites restores favorites from a backup file.
  • Copy Profile copies the current result text or JSON.
Content Pool and creator filters
  • Use Content Pool to switch between official, modded, or mixed content.
  • Creator filters help narrow modded traits, aspirations, preferences, skills, talents, weaknesses, and careers.
  • Lumpinou entries are included as talent and weakness prompts, not as new skills.
Favorites
  • Favorites are saved in your browser, not in an account.
  • Export favorites occasionally if you want a backup.
  • Import favorites if you move to another browser, device, or uploaded site.
Troubleshooting
  • If something feels too specific, set that dropdown back to Any.
  • If a removed or outdated tab ever appears, refresh the page and generate again.
  • If you use Favorites often, export a backup occasionally.
About This Generator
Created by Kaggy

I wanted a truly extensive Sims generator, but I could never find one that went as deep as I wanted, so I decided to make one myself.

This generator is very much shaped around the way I personally play. You will notice custom occults, expanded lore, and unique descriptions that are not part of standard Sims gameplay. They are included because they are useful for my own saves and storytelling.

Feel free to use as much or as little of that as you like. You can ignore any custom occults, lore, or options that do not fit your game and simply use the parts that help you create Sims, households, and stories.
